links.outcome: Frequency of hallucinated (factually incorrect or nonsensical) responses in benchmarking of LLM summaries
links.effect: Hallucination was reported as rare and responses generally consistent; model choice and domain-specific training affected response quality. No numbers given in abstract.
links.quote: Benchmarking and comparative assessment indicated that the model responses were generally consistent, and hallucination, ie, factually incorrect or nonsensical response was rare; treatment- and outcome related queries led to context-aware responses, and response time correlated with verbosity.

unlisted_practices: Domain-specific training of LLMs on a curated local corpus to improve response quality

screen.reason: Evaluates a custom generative LLM tool (Oncointerpreter.ai) for interactive summarization of cancer pathology and genomics data for patients and clinicians using case studies and benchmark assessment.
